main_text.l: Chaldaei pluries hoc respectu cum aquilis conferuntur.

volatu impetuosiores, quandò ad praedam festinant, e-
jusque prospectu vehementius irritantur: Cons. Job. 9: 26.
Prov. 30: 19. Matth. 24: 28. Hinc forte
aquila olim adoptata fuit à pluribus gentibus inter signa
militaria. Vide Lydii Syntagma rei militaris sacrum
pag. 87. &c. Faciunt haec ad iudicii certitudinem, & quasi
occupationem objectionis includunt; cogitabit enim
quis longius à Judæa remotam esse Chaldæorum
gentem, quam ut molestam adeo expeditionem cum
successu absolvere possit: cui opponit hominum durius
educatorum robur, & impetum; quippe qui haud fa-
cilè ex longis itineribus delassantur, ut aquilino impe-
tu maximam terrarum distantiam intra pauciores dies fa-
cillimè absolvant.

subjungit, totus ille ad violentam-vexationem

domi relicto, qui arma gerere potest. Notatur autem

page.notes: The asterisk between "impe-tu" and "maximam" is a printer's mark, not a note. The verse heading "quorum" and "congregaverit" are set in italic and are copied as printed. The printed "Verf." is read as "Vers." (long s). The line ending "infer-" is incomplete at the foot of the page and continues on the next page. Some italic and roman distinctions in the commentary are uncertain and may not be exact.
